hardware.precision: FP32 parameter/residual storage with CUDA BF16 autocast; PC branch FP32

protocol.input: fixed seed823 synthetic FP32 standard-normal image, all 784 patches in FOV
protocol.checkpoint_selection: predeclared BRSET seed823 fold1, selected own-INNER checkpoint; no best-result selection
protocol.flop_convention: one multiplication-accumulation = two FLOPs; theoretical dense arithmetic only
protocol.scope: image patch embed plus all 12 frozen encoder blocks plus actual task decision; training teacher excluded
protocol.comparison: single fixed architecture/input inference benchmark, not five-seed accuracy assessment
protocol.fov: synthetic full-FOV structural cost; real RGB-FOV extraction excluded
protocol.checkpoint_caches: not used; no FP16 feature-cache quantization in these common full forwards
protocol.ordering: fixed displayed variant order, single process, no parallel GPU work requested; not randomized

flops.attention_counting: QK^T and AV counted by native SDPA rules or decomposed BMM, once only
excluded: lesion probability sigmoid and reference/query normalization
pair differences, rectification and weighted readout elementwise reductions
boolean checks, indexing, permutation, shape/cast/copy and memory movement

inference.memory_scope: PyTorch allocator; includes this registered model, input/FOV/permutation buffers and forward temporaries; excludes CUDA context/driver, external allocations and training gradients/optimizer
inference.timing_scope: resident synthetic image plus resident full-FOV metadata to logit; full uncached encoder; original Python validation/check overhead retained; excludes image IO, resize/normalization, FOV extraction, transfers and patient aggregation
